_meta.title: Pipeline script (Qwen3-VL TextGenerate)
_meta.description: LLM script step for the Shorts Studio and Click to Ad pipelines, core ComfyUI only. CLIPLoader loads Qwen3-VL 8B (text_encoders/qwen3vl_8b_bf16.safetensors, Apache-2.0, the same file Qwen-Image 2.1 uses as its text encoder) as a generate-capable model; TextGenerate writes a JSON scene list from the compiled prompt; PreviewAny returns it as a text output. The optional LoadImage (node 2) feeds the product photo to TextGenerate for ads and is deleted when the source run has no image. Builder: src/lib/oj/pipelineScript.ts (prompt from src/lib/tools/pipelines.ts scriptPrompt).
